blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Verified source for the immutable Ethereum token 0xb122f4a154f84708407213d6a715181180012f45 restricts minting and burning to registered branch BorrowerOperations and ActivePool contracts and exposes no holder blacklist, freeze, seizure or global transfer pause; owner() returned the zero address and the EIP-1967 implementation slot was empty at block 26196851 (October 15 2026). The protocol documentation states the token and Liquity v2 core cannot freeze a particular user's JPYdf. The inherited verdict reflects backing rather than a direct holder control: at the same block the dUSDC branch held 586,394 USDC against 79.39 wstETH in the dwstETH branch, so freezable USDC made up about 71% of collateral value at the oracle's last good prices. The governance-upgradeable and pausable dToken vault layer can also halt collateral exits during an impairment.
